title: AV4: a refund never settles a pay, whatever its size
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027: the bank holds 300,000. Pay of 250,000 on the 25th (moved earlier). On Mon 25 Jan a refund of 250,000 for a returned laptop comes in; the bank statement read on Tue 26 Jan shows it as a refund line. The pay has not come yet. Every amount is made up.

asks.question: days_to_next_pay
asks.why: The refund line is money in of the pay's size inside its window, but a refund never settles a pay [AV4]: the 25 Jan pay is still late, expected (its posting window ends Tue 26 Jan).
